subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] x86/boot/startup: Disable kernel stack depth tracking

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch disables kernel stack depth tracking in the x86 boot startup code to prevent a linker error when building the vmlinux image. The issue arises from the fact that the startup code is linked with every symbol prefixed by __pi_, which prevents it from calling into the rest of the kernel, making stack depth tracking unnecessary. The patch fixes this by using the correct macro DISABLE_KSTACK_ERASE to disable tracking, resolving a linker error introduced by a previous commit.
